notes:
Summary: LumenBridge is a mid-market SaaS company that provides a multitenant customer support knowledge base product. They want to replace an in-house hybrid search stack with a managed RAG pipeline (embeddings + ANN retrieval + reranking) to improve relevance and reduce ops. Prefer Redwood hosted API for faster time-to-value.

Key metrics asked on call: indexing scale ~350k canonical KB documents (after dedupe) -> ~1.2M embeddings with chunking; peak QPS target 250-350 for search endpoints during business hours; batch reindex cadence nightly with incremental updates; expected growth ~2x in 12 months.

Latency/cost goals: Retrival + top-10 rerank end-to-end <300ms p95 (prefer <200ms); reranker-only latency for top-100 candidate scoring <120ms p95. Cost sensitivity: target cost per query (amortized) <$0.002 at scale; will trade model size vs throughput if Redwood can show unit economics.

Model preferences: open-embedding model preferred for compliance; golden rerank model: prefer a distilled instruction-tuned open model (70B too expensive) or Redwood-curated reranker. They asked about quantized variants and kernel selection for lower-latency scoring.

Security: Must pass SSO/SAML and audit logging; KMS for key management; retention policy for transcripts 90 days. Data residency not strict (US/EU ok).

From AE notes: "CTO said: 'If you can hit 200–250 QPS with <200ms p95 and show stable costs, we can close this quarter.'" — strong exec alignment.

POC ask: 2-week hosted POC (ingest 350k docs, configure ANN index, run synthetic QPS ramp to 350 QPS, measure p95 latency and cost), plus integration test with their support UI and SSO login. Redwood to provide a sample config for batching, KV caching, and recommended quantization profile.

Sales/ops notes: pricing sensitivity vs. Pinecone + in-house — emphasize end-to-end rerank throughput (not just ANN). Need price deck + example TCO for 12/24 month horizons. Legal requested standard DPA + addendum for security controls.

pricing_concerns: Need clear TCO that includes embedding refresh costs, reranker token units, and ANN storage. Competitor comps: Pinecone (embeddings+ANN) + self-managed reranker vs Redwood end-to-end.
